t: This is the Fan Museum, on Croom's Hill in Greenwich. It occupies two grade II* listed houses built in 1721, inside the Greenwich World Heritage Site. It opened in 1991 and is the world's first museum dedicated to preserving and displaying hand fans. Hélène Alexander, a fan collector and author, founded it. Besides the galleries, the museum has an orangery decorated with murals. Outside there is a Japanese-style garden with a fan-shaped parterre, a pond and a stream, so it's worth looking out the back as well.
